acceptance: Every declared delta >=0.002; at least one non-clock input admitted for numerical panels; exact replays and integrity checks. Review only.
distinction: Error versus the historical as-of prior at origin s, NOT an in-sample residual of the fitted forecaster.
model: Original histogram configuration, preprocessing and target scaling; no tuning or online refitting.
prerequisite_new_rounds: The corrected preflight; no score from rounds16/17/18 enters this plan.
reference_error: (outcome[s] - released_priors.location_126[s]) / released_priors.risk_126[s], clipped to [-12,12], released at s+h+1.
selected_new_features: Fixed groups; only training missingness/constant/duplicate screening.
threshold: Fixed |standardized reference error| > 2; not an optimized alarm threshold.
uncertainty: Paired 10/20/40-origin blocks, conditional on fitted models. No full adaptive-search correction.
validation_scope: Previously inspected last development period, NOT an untouched final holdout.
